par.source: Genome Reference Consortium and Ensembl GRCh38 PAR boundaries; converted from 1-based inclusive to 0-based half-open

xtr.source: SexChrLab/VariantCalling resources/genomic_features GRCh38 BED files, lifted from Webster et al. 2019
xtr.required_action: Recompute Y compartments from retained interval summaries before mLOY analysis

notes: The imported X_NONPAR compartment depends only on the official PAR boundaries and is compatible with this sex gate.
The imported Y_NONPAR_NONXTR ratio used an older provisional XTR approximation and is audit-only here.
No sex label is overwritten; inferred sex is stored separately.
